SELECT orders.o_orderpriority AS orders_o_orderpriority, count(*) AS order_count 
FROM orders 
WHERE orders.o_orderdate >= %s AND orders.o_orderdate < %s AND (EXISTS (SELECT 1 
FROM lineitem 
WHERE lineitem.l_orderkey = orders.o_orderkey AND lineitem.l_commitdate < lineitem.l_receiptdate)) GROUP BY orders.o_orderpriority ORDER BY orders.o_orderpriority

statements.sql:
SELECT o_orderpriority, COUNT(*) AS order_count
FROM orders
WHERE o_orderdate >= :b0
  AND o_orderdate < :b1
  AND EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM lineitem
              WHERE l_orderkey = o_orderkey
                AND l_commitdate < l_receiptdate)
GROUP BY o_orderpriority
ORDER BY o_orderpriority
